user.title: Texecom Alerts
user.description: Point this at the texecom2mqtt bridge. The site gateway fields are optional but recommended, so a site that has lost power or its line can be told apart from a panel that has simply gone quiet.

areas.title: Areas
areas.description: These were discovered from retained MQTT messages. Choose the ones to monitor.

notify.title: Notifications
notify.description: Pick one or more phones for push. Choose them from the dropdown, no notify group needed. SMS and voice are optional but are what actually wake somebody at three in the morning. Recipient numbers apply to SMS and voice only.

data.auto_phones: Send to every Companion app phone automatically, telling iOS and Android apart on their own
data.push_services: Phones for push (only used when automatic is off)
data.recipients: Recipient numbers for SMS and voice in E.164 format
data.escalate_tampers: Escalate tamper alarms as emergencies (voice calls)
data.fire_zones: Fire zones, by name or number (a fire alarm link, always raises a loud fire alert separate from intruder alarms, even while disarmed)
data.notify_arm_disarm: Notify when an area is armed or disarmed
data.notify_activity: Notify on other activity such as door access, user codes and remote commands
data.phone_ack: Let keyholders acknowledge by phone (Twilio, needs a public HTTPS URL Twilio trusts)
data.ack_endpoint: Acknowledgement relay URL (optional, a Twilio Function that forwards to Home Assistant, for a self signed certificate)
data.critical_sound: Emergency sound (iOS, filename of a sound imported into the Companion app, or default)
data.fire_sound: Fire sound (iOS, filename of a separate sound imported into the Companion app, so fire is told from an intruder by ear; leave blank to use the emergency sound)
data.tts_siren_services: Android phones for a maximum volume spoken siren (only used when automatic is off)

error.no_areas: No areas seen on that prefix. Check the bridge is running and the prefix matches its configuration.

init.title: Texecom Alerts options
init.description: Changes take effect immediately. No restart needed.
